summary: All 23 sounds of switches (8), alarms (6), sensors (5) and radio (4) are rendered into assets/audio/render and in the manifest. Every sound passes every hard rule (peak, clipping, DC, onset, silent end, loop seam, energy shares, band rules). 14 of 23 have a negative CLAP margin: the design follows the intent sentences and I stopped after three honest attempts. radio.py (filter plus command line) is written; with three 20 s NASA speech clips the word error rate is 0 %, 2.6 % and 8.9 % (rule 15 %), with short 1.5 to 2.5 s clips it fails.
built: tools/audio/synth/cat_switches.py (relays, toggle, rotary, breaker, key, power up and down)
tools/audio/synth/cat_alarms.py (six alarms; also holds the tone helpers phase_of, voice, gate, speaker, bell_env)
tools/audio/synth/cat_sensors.py (five sensor signals, imports helpers from cat_alarms)
tools/audio/synth/cat_radio.py (squelch open and close, static loop, tone)
tools/audio/synth/radio.py (radio_filter() and command line: input output [--drive] [--noise-db])

verified: Final build of all 23 ids in one call: 23 rendered, none failed a hard rule; manifest validates (114 sounds in it, including other agents'). The table is in docs/reports/2026-11-14/.synth-signals-build.txt and below.
Unit tests of the library still pass (15).

Alarm envelopes printed with measure.py (20 ms or 30-50 ms per character): heat '  *@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@+  @@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@%' (two long blocks), missile '  %@@@@@    @@@@@*   %@@@@@    @@@@@*   %@@@@@' (five short pulses), shields_down three blocks then a long staircase down, fuel_low one start and a decay of 1.4 s, hull_critical one long and one short block, master_caution two sharp starts with decays. All six differ in rhythm and contour.
Pictures opened and looked at: relay_click_b, systems_power_up, sensor_explosion_outside, radio_static_loop.

radio.py command line runs. Word error rate (filtered against the transcript of the original, whisper-small, default filter): 20 s of Artemis II comm check 0.0 %, 20 s of Artemis II go for TLI 2.6 %, 20 s of ISS safe haven call 8.9 %. All three pass the 15 % rule.
notVerified: Nothing was heard. Whether relays, toggle and key sound like mechanics or like clicks of a different kind is only measured, not judged.
The describing model (--describe) was not run.
Spectrogram pictures of 19 of the 23 sounds were not opened; for those only the numbers were read.

Short speech clips fail the radio rule: three NASA clips of 1.5 to 2.5 s gave WER 0.83, 0.33, 0.80 with the default filter. A pure band-pass without overdrive and noise gave 0.67, 0.33, 0.00, so most of it is whisper-small on very short, already poor recordings (its own transcripts of the unfiltered clips were wrong, for example 'Houston Discovery, how do you reach?'), but the overdrive and noise add some loss. Not further investigated.
radio_filter was not run on the rendered radio sounds' downstream mixing in the audition page.
deviations: 14 of 23 sounds have a negative CLAP margin and show FAIL clap-margin in the build: relay_click_a, relay_click_b, switch_toggle, switch_rotary, button_press, all alarms except fuel_low, sensor_proximity_tick, sensor_explosion_outside, radio_squelch_close, radio_static_loop. Each had up to three attempts; the design was kept (see doubt per sound). The brief allows this; the exit code of the build will be 1 because of it.

LEVELS: sensors, radio and the power-up/down sounds had no entry; I added them from my category files with LEVELS.update(...) at import time (values: sensors -27 LUFS, radio_tone and squelch -14 dBFS peak, radio_static_loop -32 LUFS, power up/down -14 dBFS peak). That is a small hack outside the library file; it should be moved into levels.py.
systems_power_up fades to silence over the last 0.9 s, which the intent sentence does not ask for.

Helper functions written in my own files (to be moved into the library): cat_alarms.py: phase_of, voice, gate, speaker, bell_env; cat_switches.py: tick, ring, thunk, _finish (taper that reaches zero 12 ms before the end), in_cabin, relay.
Loop alarms with silence (heat, missile, fuel_low, hull_critical) are registered with swing_max=80 because the pattern is the content.
openIssues: Switch and relay sounds sit at -0.0 to -0.13 CLAP against 'a hand clap'; probably they need an ear judgement.
alarm_hull_critical cannot be made lower and heavier without leaving the 400 Hz fundamental rule.
Short-clip speech through radio_filter fails the WER rule with whisper-small; if a short line must pass, the drive and noise defaults could be lowered, untested.
The cabin reverb tail is cut at the file end (apply_cabin is not circular for one-shots), so the 0.15 s relay files taper the reverb by an artificial fade.
forNextAgent: Build my four categories: .venv-audio/Scripts/python.exe tools/audio/build.py --only <ids from sounds.json> (the --category flag takes one category). Radio filter: .venv-audio/Scripts/python.exe tools/audio/synth/radio.py in.wav out.wav [--drive 2.0] [--noise-db -40] (standalone; radio_filter(x, sr, drive, noise_db, seed) in code). Use `from .radio import radio_filter` inside cat files. Pitfalls: heredocs containing python in the Bash tool hung here, use the Write or Edit tools; apply_cabin cuts the reverb at the file length, so a one-shot needs its own taper that reaches zero 12 ms before the end (see _finish in cat_switches.py); the alarm fundamental estimator and the 5 kHz energy rule fail quickly with strong harmonics above 4 kHz; the loop-edge level rule needs silence (or equal level) at both ends of a pulsed loop.
